vo.en: You are walking into a trap.

visual.description: Close-up of a man's leather boots stepping onto a clean, shiny supermarket floor.

vo.en: Next time you’re shopping, look closely at the floor tiles under your cart. Notice anything?

visual.description: POV shot of hands pushing a metal shopping cart through a grocery aisle.

vo.en: In the expensive aisles, the tiles are often cut much smaller than in the basic sections.

visual.description: Low angle shot of a grid of square tiles with a hand pointing at the lines.

vo.en: Wait until you hear the creepy reason why.

visual.description: Extreme close-up of a man's eyes widening in realization.

vo.en: As you push your cart, those smaller tiles make your wheels click-clack twice as fast.

visual.description: Macro shot of a shopping cart wheel spinning quickly and vibrating on a textured surface.

vo.en: That rapid sound tricks your brain into thinking you’re sprinting through the aisles like a maniac.

visual.description: A classic analog stopwatch with the needle spinning around the dial at high speed.

vo.en: You instinctively slow your pace to stop rushing, which leads to you buying twenty-nine percent more.

visual.description: A man's hand adding several premium glass jars and items into an already full cart.

vo.en: Check the floor on your next trip and subscribe for more daily hacks because...

visual.description: A wide, cinematic shot of a brightly lit, empty supermarket aisle stretching into the distance.
